newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares losses as long bond recovers.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares losses as long bond recovers.

text.p: Mexican peso contracts halted their initial slide against the dollar by midmorning on Tuesday, tracking a turnaround by the U.S. long bond, traders said.
"The dollar was in demand at the open because of the long bond, but they've stepped back in to sell now," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were trading 1.4 and 1.3 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.8120/7.8150 and 7.8100/7.8130 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had closed for the day 3.4 centavos weaker at 7.8070/7.8100 per dollar.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond had reversed an early slide and was up 2/32 to yield 6.40 percent.
